# Pinned Modified Tools sources

The JSON and Java files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`.

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2

The manifest records source paths and SHA-256 hashes. The advancement only
adapts its icon item key. The native item predicate retains the modifiable
item-tag gate and reads installed upgrades from the port's native saved
representation, not material traits or total modifier levels.
